name: Swansea University
description:
Do you want to study at a university known as a University that lives up to this reputation with its commitment to inclusion and diversity?

Swansea University has been awarded four stars in the latest QS Stars international rating system for its international focus!

It offers over 250 undergraduate and 120 postgraduate courses, many of which are accredited by international professional bodies.

Over 40% of its students are over 25 years old on enrolment and its staff provide networks and resources to benefit gender, disability, race, and lifestyle.

About the University

The third biggest university in Wales, Swansea University was established in 1920 as a college that was part of the University of Wales. It became a university in its own right in 2007 and has 8 colleges spread out across two campuses with around 20,000 students including international students from over 130 different countries.

Its waterfront campuses make for an attractive location to study and it is home to the Hillary Rodham Clinton School of Law, which was named after the former US First Lady. Swansea University is listed as one of the top 500 universities in the world and 24th in the UK according to The Guardianâ€™s 2022 University Guide.

The University has a Centre for Excellence and recently invested millions into their campus. The University offers facilities such as an atrium, coffee area, study space and shared kitchen for student use. The campus is situated along a beachfront so students benefit from a picturesque view as they study. Swansea University library offers specific subject help and support, inclusive services support, writing assignment help and other services.

Student Life

Swansea University operates an International Welcome Programme so international students can settle comfortably into their new home. Social activities, events and monthly trips are also organised by University staff so students find it easy to socialise together. The Student Union has more than 150 societies for students to choose from, including the Real Ale and Visual Arts society.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Looking for a top-ranked university in Wales with a focus on research-led teaching? Swansea University is your perfect choice. Swansea is ranked among the best universities in the UK and offers you a diverse range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across various disciplines. These include Engineering, Business, Health Sciences, Law, and Environmental Science.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value: With over 130 student societies and sports clubs, you’ll have many opportunities to meet new people. The Swansea University Students’ Union provides a range of services, from mental health support to financial advice, ensuring you feel supported throughout your university journey.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Swansea University offers you a variety of modern, high-quality accommodation options, with and without catering. In both campuses, you can choose from en-suite rooms, shared flats, and studio apartments.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The Swansea University Library is one of the largest in Wales, offering extensive resources for your studies, including thousands of books, journals, and digital materials.

Sports
Swansea University is home to one of the UK’s top 30 sports departments. You can participate in over 40 different sports, and you’ll always stay active with state-of-the-art sports centres, including a gym, tennis courts, and an Olympic-size swimming pool.

Laboratory
The university provides you with cutting-edge equipment for teaching and research. You’ll find different laboratories for disciplines such as engineering, medicine, computer science, and life sciences.

Cafeteria
The university offers you a range of dining options, from quick bites to full meals. The Bay View Cafe offers a stunning seaside view while you enjoy a fresh range of meals. You also have cafes in many academic buildings providing you with hot drinks and snacks.
